name: polyp-combo-stack
description: ACCEPTANCE, two-enemy combination (?polyp=2): the polyp locks the post-mid lane and the judged hound-rejoin beat prices the drop reroute directly beneath it — dodging the beam now lands the bot in a charging hound's patrol. Same closed-loop skeleton as polyp-lane-dodge (funnel into the lane while the iris is quiet, drop through on polypTell, re-mount between volleys, vault out after 10.5s), plus the proven policy-hound-reactive answer: tap jump whenever a hound telegraphs. The run demonstrates the vertical stack: polyp cycles above, hound tells/charges below, and the bot has to answer BOTH with movement verbs on the same decision point. Expected VICTORY with kills 0; hp and hull-fallback setbacks are reported honestly (the stack is allowed to cost — that is what it is for; at 1 hp a bulb contact triggers the slice's own HULL FALLBACK mercy, which restores hp, dislodges a route down and counts a setback). The regression signals are a stall, or the hound/polyp never both engaging in the trace.
